snippet.title: Lords of the Fallen II – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Lords of the Fallen II is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 this fall.

Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom.

A millennium after the Great Rupture, the Umbral darkness has consumed almost all. One Kingdom remains—a sacred land shrouded by an ancient force. But as light fades, darkness rises, and the Eternal Night draws near. A hero must rise, for a God to fall.

#LordsoftheFallen2 #LOTF #NintendoDirect #NintendoSwitch2
